description:
The latest technical audit of the workspace's own website: a 0-100 health score, every issue found (crawling and indexing, on-page, links, speed, and AI search) with how many pages it affects, why it matters and how to fix it, and whether robots.txt lets the AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot...) in and llms.txt exists.

Use when the user asks what is technically wrong with their site, why AI or Google may not read it, or what to fix first -- phrases like 'what does the site audit say', 'which pages are broken', 'are we blocking AI crawlers'. Needs the Web add-on. For any public page without an add-on, use audit_page instead.

Example: 'What are the most important fixes on our website?'
